nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Clarifying Clay Face Mask for Oily Skin

avis.texte: I usually use the philosophy clay mask but decided to give this La Roche-Posay a try for the first time. I regret my decision. It's clearly cheaper than philosophy because quality is nonexistent with this product.

I really wanted to like this mask. It makes my skin feel so soft after but i can not use it. It says to keep it on for 5 mins but i can not leave it on more than 2 mins. My skin gets red and really hot, even burns.
This facemask has been really helpful for when I feel breakouts coming on. So far I have noticed reduce redness and less oily skin for a few days after use. Iv made this mask a weekly routine.

avis.titre: I would but this product over again.
avis.texte: Makes my face feel so soft after using it. I feel like this product works for me although everyone skin is different.

This is a very gentle, clay mask that doesn't burn or crack on the skin. I usually apply the mask after a shower, leave on for 5 minutes and use a cloth to remove. My skin feels deeply cleansed, soft and acne redness is blurred.

avis.titre: la roche-posay effaclar shine control clay mask
avis.texte: i really like this mask! it's a clay mask which is best for oily skin! it helps with oil control which my skin absolutely needs. it does work well although your face will still be oily after you use it so it doesn't get rid of it completely but it does help reduce it. it feels nice on the skin and is unscented. it is a bit pricey but i use once a week and it's lasted me awhile so i think it's worth it!
It broke me out, woke up with many blemishes and white heads the next day😞

I just tried this mask and it soooo good. I would give 5 stars for this La roche posey as brand, surely needs to get really overall rating for this project 5 stars. Many of the reasons are after the mask is staying even longer it than it should, is completely so light weight on the skin. You can feel once you move around your face of making any expression is completely making even tighter. My skin always is dripping of oil and the fact that is not burning, when you wear it, it unbelievable top buying product for me. This product is such a hot bomb shell. Amazingly is really good product, small packing for easy travel of 100ml and relatively affordable, nothing related with their cleaner of the same series Effaclar, which is awful. Thick consistency, the smell is completely like a pharmacy personally for me. When I was applying the mask, you can see how patchy application is going around your face but it is good that it is not cracking. A little bit though to wash off but skins feels thankful afterwards. Ps. I hope I described as detailed as possible with my experience of the mask. The chosen nickname of this review is connect with my Instagram and you can see the results
This is gentle yet effective. I use it every few days. Haven't seen dramatic change but it's not irritating so works for me
Bought for my "T" zone on my face it's an ok product,to spendy for what it does.
Too early to say how it works only used it twice, but it feels really good after I rinse it off
I'm loving this face mask! It's so light that it can easily be used once a week!
This doesn't work for people with extremely oily skin like myself. This dried me out so much that my skin became more oily than normal

I have pretty sensitive skin and I never have burning sensations with this mask. I have very oily skin and I feel I can tame it with using this once a week or so. I feel very refreshed after usage and additional products glide on smoothly afterwards.
It's great to have in your purse and carry it around. My skin has been glorious with this sunscreen
Great mask ! There's a visible difference after applying it . Skin appears clearer and brighter.

It has everything in one! It has vitamin C, E, antioxidants and has sunscreen of 50 !! It does not leave your skin dry at all, it feels super hydrated, and you do not need to put on sunscreen again, it is perfect when you put on makeup and you do not want to spray some sunscreen on cream. It is a bit expensive, but totally worth it

This is a PERFECT sunscreen in the form of a serum that goes so well underneath a moisturizer. I love how it's light and not sticky. It also doesn't leave any pale residue on my face. I just hope it was a teeny bit cheaper considering the size but I'll still choose this over any other sunscreen that goes on top of my moisturizer.
This is a wonderful, easy to use clay-based mask that can be used up to twice weekly. Especialky beneficial for oily skin.
Amazing product ! After one use instantly saw a difference in my skin becoming clearer and less oily!

Expensive but I found that this product was worth the buy. I struggled finding a sunblock that wouldn't break me out when I wore it daily under makeup/on its own. I noticed that this product even made my skin look extra glowy while protecting it from UV and pollution.

Love. Love. Love. Using daily for sun protection and moisturizing. Not super greasy like most spf product and only has a faint smell of sunscreen upon application which quickly fades! Can't recommend enough - already got my mom using this daily at her home too!
This goes on super silky and smooth with a nice light scent. It definitely controls my shine after using and does not feel cakey.

Didnt really notice much of a difference, and skin still looked dull. My skin is oily and sensitive. I am not a big fan of this product and will probably try a different one. The consistency is also so thin, and the amount of product is too less. I would not buy again

I'm not sure how I feel about this serum. It defiantly works and smells like sunscreen. I do think it would be better used solely as a sunscreen and not so much a serum. It leaves your face a little oily but a setting powder like Laura Mercier Loose Setting Powder Translucent 29G/1Oz is an easy fix to that! Or a matte foundation (I use Nars Velvet Matte Skin Tint Broad Spectrum Spf 30 )
After using the skin is so fin and clean. I really recommend for sensitive skin as well.
very good for oily skin you will get a difference after using

Okay. This stuff scared me at first. It applies like a serum (because it is a serum) but doesnt really sink in like one is supposed to. I put it on and my face looked really greasy. But here's the key. After I apply it, I put the la roche posay tinted mineral sunscreen on over it which dries to a matte finish and VOILA! NO MORE GREASE FACE. I like this stuff because it has vitamin C in it! Will rebuy!

Most amazing sunscreen! I use this both under my makeup or just on its own on no makeup days, and it stays looking beautiful. It doesn't leave my face with a white cast, no powerful sunscreen smell, and I have dry skin and it even helps to make my skin feel more moisturized. I actually like my makeup better when I wear this sunscreen underneath instead of just moisturizer and primer. It feels so nourishing. It is definitely on the pricier side, but well worth it.

This Is my everyday facial sunscreen no matter what I do i always use this after my facial routine. It smells so good I love the old school sunscreen smell and that's what this smells like. Not sticky at all. 10-10 my fav daily for the face
This sunscreen does not irritate my skin, and I prefer mineral sunscreens. Layers fine with makeup, it's definitely moisturizing with a light, dewy feel.
Problem skin no more! Effeclar is the perfect balance for problem skin. Powerful and effective. I have used it for years.

Great sunscreen, is not greasy, perfect to use under make up as it doesn't mess up anything, it is a little pricey, I just went thru my first bottle after a month of daily use , I do think I was using too much (2 to 3 pumps) . I'm repurchasing even tho is pricey
Love this product. The mask takes impurities out of my skin and leaves my face feeling supple and smooth.
it leaves your face clean and it's quick you don't take it off in the classic 20 minutes.
I like this mask, my only cons is that it doesn't control the excessive oil and shine but in the other hand eliminated impurities and you feel your skin smooth.

Helpful against shine and a nice deep clean feel, especially on the days I use it. The off days between masques, however, I seem to still get pretty oily. I'm just starting to the use the masque so I'll need to tweak to my skin's unique needs. Overall I am happy with the masque!

I stumbled upon this product accidentally while trying to burn some FSA dollars and fell in love. Sunscreen usually has a weird chalky texture but this serum goes on very smoothly & doesn't leave any residue. It's thin enough to spread around the eyes without feeling like I'm rubbing too hard & the fragrance is barely noticeable. Living in Arizona, avoiding sun damage is really important & I'm thrilled to have found a product with SPF 50 that isn't annoying to use. It hasn't caused my skin to break out & I now purchase it on purpose!

works really good at getting rid of excess oil helping to control daily shine. one question that I have is when applying do you rub it between hands and use both hands for application or do you put some on finger and spread it on little by little?
As face sunscreen, this is a very nice product. It goes on easily, and quickly blends in. However, it is too oily and greasy to wear under makeup.

ADORE this product. It's non greasy, fabulously light on the skin, and does not have a strong sunscreen smell to it. The best thing about it is that it layers really nicely under the rest of my skincare and makeup (serum, lotion, CC cream). I have been through so many sunscreens for daily use - I'll never stop buying this.
I have an oily t-zone and wanted to try this product to help control that. It works great. Easy to use, easy to remove, left my skin feeling soft and magnified. I need hardly any makeup!

Best facial sunscreen around! I got a sample from my dermatologist a year ago and for the beach and pool it's great! I can wear it all day and don't burn, and zero breakouts. It does run into my eyes when i train and do my long runs, but is otherwise fantastic!
Having combination skin makes cleansing a more difficult process, this mask makes my skin more balanced and less likely to get oily.

I generally like La Roche Posay products. This mask goes on easy and washed off easy It has no scent which is great :) Worked well on me,left my face feeling moisturized and clean . I used it once a week for a deep cleaning of my pores.
the mask is good. really helps. suitable for sensitive skin. but the composition is not very clean

This is my favourite mask to use when I feel like my skin needs some rescue fast! It clears out my pores amazingly! It makes my skin look shine free for days! Its perfect to use just before doing makeup! Ive recommended this product to a lot of customers and they all love it. Its perfect for sensitive oily skin! It works just as good as the origins 10 min rescue mask without the chemical scent and and half the cost!
Helps unclog pore and minimizes the size of my pores. I have a lot of little white bumps under the surface of my skin and this helps with that

I found this facial treatment very satisfying for my oily skin and I think I'm going to buy it again once it's going to finish. It was my first time using it and I was really curious about it because I already use a face cream of the same brand.
Great product, definitely removes oils. I have combo skin and dont find it too stripping. Dont find it does anything for my pores
My first impression was not very good. But when I was using it daily I saw that is was removing my makeup quite well.
I have only used the product once but I like the effect it gives. Makes my face feel soft and mattified. I also like how it doesnt dry out like other clay masks on your face

I love this product I uses this when my face its so oily to make my pores not that much oily its kinda pricy but it works great I get this product twice a year because I love using this plus it last me for a long time

avis.titre: Got this in a set with...
avis.texte: Got this in a set with my Clarisonic Mia purchase. I use it 1-2x a week per the directions. It does the job, makes my skin feel smoother. But it doesn't give any huge benefit for making me less oily. It does about as well as other drugstore brands I've tried.

This mask to let ask about ten minutes on the face and the neck makes it possible to embellish the skin. Its texture is light and easily removed. The skin is soft and hydrated. I use it once a week for 1 year and I am very satisfied. Only small problem, its high enough price

This is a great light serum sunscreen. This works very well under makeup. It is rare to find such a light SPF 50, though it is a little pricier. It is lightly moisturizing as well and if you don't have drier skin then this could be sufficient as a moisturizer as well.

Great sunscreen! Most SPFs I've used in the past feel heavy and oily, and don't look great with makeup but this one is one of my favorites! Feels super smooth on the skin like all of my non-SPF serums and on top of that has a great level of sun protection!
I love this product! I have used up several of these little bottles! firstly it comes with a pump and it's super light weight. Wears great under makeup and it's very moisturizing!

After using this product for a month, it has helped my skin decently. I don't recommend it as your go-to for instant clearing off the skin. Instead, I recommend it as an addition to your face cleansing regime. It has helped my oil in my pores and on top of my skin stayed controlled as it claims.

I like this sunscreen, however, it's kind of oily but it does not leave white marks. This is my first time trying it and I would not mind buying it again. I have not seen and effects of sun spots so I hope it is working. Overall I think the product could be better if it was not as oily.

I purchased this about a month ago, hoping that I would see a change within my skin but so far nothing. It smells good and is different from most clay masks. I use it for relaxing instead of clearing my acne.

I use this once a week and you can really see the results once you wash the mask off. The texture is not too sticky, not too dry-ish and my face is really oil free, clean feeling, and mattified the rest of the day. I love having this in my once a week regime.
